answer.reason: Only his birth as the twin who broke out ahead of his brother is told as an event; the other verses are genealogies, lists or a blessing.

clauses.english: was born first of twins, breaking out ahead of his brother Zerah
clauses.quote: as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out

doubts: The marked verses in Numbers, Chronicles, Nehemiah, Matthew and Luke only list his descendants or line, so they are not used.
RUT 4:12 is a blessing, not an event.
